paragraphs.text: A live, searchable trace waterfall for DeepSeek Harness.
# DSH trace waterfall
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that replaces the trajectory view with a trace waterfall inspired by Kobra
. The presentation is independently implemented; no Kobra code or assets are included.

- Turn rows show model, tool, waiting, handoff, and failed activity as one segmented bar.
- A three-
lane overview (input / model / tools) supports drag-to-zoom; long idle gaps collapse into axis break

s, and any turn can be focused.
- Model bars split time to first token from decoding.
- Click a row
or bar for an anchored summary, then open full details for complete input, output, timing, and metad
ar for an anchored summary, then open full details for complete input, output, timing, and metadata.
## Video
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe12bc0d-32b7-4761-8996-d7ae5887637a
A 100-second tour: the built-in trajectory view for comparison, the main interactions, and a real ag
ent run recorded live.

## Install
Requires Node 24.9+ and pnpm 11 on `PATH` (`dsh plugin` uses pnpm; pnpm 10 fails with `ERR_PNPM_ADDI
NG_TO_ROOT`). Tested with DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** and the 0.2.2-alpha line (master at `ce7073d`); DSH's p
lugin APIs are pre-stable.
Install from GitHub:

The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` disables `ui-trajectory` and adds `trace-waterfall`. The view ID sta
ys `trajectory`, so existing view preferences and tool-inspection links keep working. Restart DSH We
b or reload the browser after installing.
To update to the latest commit, run the same `add` command again.
To restore DSH's original trace:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Do not enable both trajectory providers at once; they own the same view.
## Develop
Requires a built DeepSeek Harness checkout of `master` or `dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2` and later. The 0.2.1
release line still runs the plugin, but `tsc` fails there because the PTC event types live in `@deep
seek-ai/dsh-tools` instead of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-ptc`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`link:dsh` links the DSH packages and generates TypeScript paths; rerun it after reinstalling depend
encies or switching checkouts.
The built `lib/` is committed so that GitHub installs need no build step. Run `npm run build` and co
mmit `lib/` together with source changes.
To install your working copy instead of the GitHub version, run `dsh plugin --profile web add .` fro
m the repository root.
To try the plugin without installing it, run from the DSH checkout:

## Usage
- **Zoom**: drag across the overview to select a range; double-click to reset. The target icon on a

turn focuses it.
- **Live following**: running sessions open at the bottom. New rows stay in view wh
ile you remain there; scrolling up, searching, filtering errors, focusing a turn, or opening a summa

ry pauses following. Scroll back to the bottom to resume. Historical sessions open at the top.
- **S
table live axis**: the global view reserves space ahead of the latest call and expands in rounded bl
ocks. Completed bars stay fixed between expansions; when the session ends, the axis fits the recorde

d end time. Manual zoom and turn focus keep their selected range.
- **Search**: Ctrl/Cmd+F. Matches

in names, arguments, prompts, and outputs are highlighted.
- **Errors only**: lists failed operation
s with their parent context. A recovered failure adds an error badge to its turn instead of marking

the whole turn red.
- **Escape** closes the summary or details, or clears filters.
## Notes
- Total tokens = uncached input + cache-read input + cache-write input + output, matching the DSH st

atus bar. Cache hit rate is cache-read input divided by all input.
- Idle gaps longer than 60 second

s are compressed; recorded durations are unchanged.
- Independent child-agent sessions are not merge

d into the parent trace.
- Cost is not shown, since recorded traces carry no authoritative pricing.
- The plugin is presentation-only: it adds no tools, changes no agent behavior, and sends no telemet
he plugin is presentation-only: it adds no tools, changes no agent behavior, and sends no telemetry.
